title: Convulsion
summary: CONVULSION, noun [Latin] 1. A preternatural, violent and involuntary contraction of the muscular parts of an animal body. 2. Any violent and irregular motion; tumult; commotion; as political convulsio

inlines.v: CONVULSION, noun [Latin] 1. A preternatural, violent and involuntary contraction of the muscular parts of an animal body. 2. Any violent and irregular motion; tumult; commotion; as political convulsions.
